title: Lahore's smog season has begun
lines: This week, Lahore was ranked the most polluted city in the world.
On Friday morning, IQAir's live ranking put Lahore first, with an air quality index of three hundred and forty-four, in the hazardous category.
New Delhi was second, at two hundred and forty-four.
In some parts of Lahore, readings were even worse. Iqbal Town reached five hundred and thirty-five, according to Geo News.
The main pollutant is fine dust, known as PM two point five, small enough to enter the bloodstream.
Punjab officials blamed easterly winds carrying polluted air from across the border, as well as local emissions.
Crop burning, traffic, factories and construction dust all add to the winter smog.
Anti-smog guns were deployed across Lahore, spraying water to settle the dust.
Then, on Saturday, rain and hail fell across the city, and the AQI dropped to about one hundred and forty-two.
But the weather is expected to turn dry again, and the smog season usually lasts into winter.
Doctors advise masks outdoors, less outdoor exercise, and extra care for children and older people.
